تبتدعوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِعُوا (tabtadiʕū) /tab.ta.di.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# تُبْتَدَعُوا (tubtadaʕū) /tub.ta.da.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
